description:
£140 PPPW - My Property Box are delighted to offer this spacious six-bedroom student maisonette to the rental market, ideally situated on Tavistock Road in the heart of Jesmond.

Perfectly positioned for student living, the property is conveniently located close to a fantastic range of local amenities, including Tesco, Waitrose and Starbucks. West Jesmond Metro Station is also nearby, providing excellent transport links to both Newcastle University and Northumbria University.

The property offers generous accommodation throughout, comprising six double bedrooms and two modern shower rooms, making it an ideal choice for a group of students looking for comfortable and convenient living in this popular area.

Don't miss out on this fantastic student property! Contact My Property Box today on 0191 212 0400 to arrange your viewing.
